title: Execute agreement
purpose: Record that a draft agreement was signed.

items.label: Signed on
items.description: Required; when the last party signed, not in the future.

items.label: Expires on
items.description: Optional; not before the effective date.

items.label: Where the signed agreement is filed
items.description: Required unless an executed copy is already attached as a document. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept in the timeline. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

Only a draft can be executed; otherwise the form shows Not available. From then on the terms are fixed. Dispatch under it needs it to be in effect on the dispatch date and on the day the dispatch is recorded. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
